hook: Two 14-year-olds were stuck on a sea cliff.
narration: Two fourteen-year-old boys were stuck on this cliff above the Oregon coast.
Fire crews on the ground couldn't safely reach them at Roads End Point.
So a Coast Guard helicopter crew from Astoria lowered a rescuer down the cable.
He reached the boys on the rocks and got them ready to go up.
The pilots can't see under the aircraft, [short pause] so the crew at the hoist talks them in, foot by foot.
outcome: The Astoria crew hoisted both boys off the cliff.
title: Two boys stuck on an Oregon sea cliff
description:
A U.S. Coast Guard helicopter crew from Astoria rescued two 14-year-old boys from a cliff at Roads End Point, Oregon, on July 5, 2025, after local fire departments could not safely reach them.
